name: Kansas City Developer Conference (KCDC)
description: Kansas City's premier multi-day software development conference. Two days of sessions covering the full spectrum of software development, from architecture to devops to front-end.

name: Midwest DevOps Days
description: A community conference exploring the intersection of development and operations. Talks and open spaces format.

name: Hack the Midwest
description: The Midwest's largest hackathon. 24+ hours of building, learning, and competing for prizes across many tracks.

name: BarCamp Kansas City
description: An unconference for Kansas City's tech and creative communities. Sessions are proposed and voted on the day-of by attendees.

name: Global Day of Code Retreat
description: A worldwide event where developers come together to practice the craft of software development. Free, focused on deliberate practice.
